name: Badge
description: A small label that states a status or category, like Paid, Overdue or Beta. Not interactive.

children.description: The label. Say what it means in words: color alone never carries the meaning.

variant.description: Tone: neutral for categories, the others for statuses.

requirements: The status is in the text, not only the color (a colored dot is decoration)
Text meets 4.5:1 against every tone's background, in light and dark mode
It is plain inline text: not focusable, not a button
screenReader: Read in place as ordinary text, e.g. "Order 1042, Overdue"

use_when: Showing the status of a record in a list or table
Tagging something with a short category or version, like Beta
avoid_when: Something the user can click or dismiss: use a Button or a tag input
A count that changes and must be announced: use a live region
anti_patterns: Using color as the only difference between two badges
